disclaimer: Advisory profile review only. This result is not a live-system scan, audit, or security certification.

findings.explanation: Tool 'issue_refund' is configured to reach more than the requesting customer's data.
findings.recommendation: Restrict the tool to the authenticated customer's records and add cross-tenant denial tests.
findings.title: A tool can act across customer boundaries

findings.explanation: If identity, policy, or a dependency check fails, the system could continue without its guardrail.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed for authorization and policy checks; define a safe fallback for unavailable dependencies.
findings.title: A control may fail open

findings.explanation: The profile does not identify a supported sign-in boundary.
findings.recommendation: Choose the customer's approved OIDC, SAML, or mutual-TLS pattern and verify its configuration.
findings.title: Enterprise authentication is not specified

findings.explanation: A shared or unspecified boundary can expose one customer's records to another.
findings.recommendation: Enforce and test a per-customer data boundary at the identity, query, and storage layers.
findings.title: Customer data isolation is unclear

findings.explanation: Prompts can contain personal, confidential, or customer-provided information.
findings.recommendation: Disable prompt-body logging by default; record metadata or an approved, time-limited sample instead.
findings.title: Prompt text is retained in logs

findings.explanation: A wildcard destination lets a compromised component contact arbitrary hosts.
findings.recommendation: Replace wildcards with the minimum named services the deployment needs; log and review denied egress.
findings.title: Outbound network access is unrestricted

findings.explanation: Tool 'issue_refund' can change customer data without an explicit human decision.
findings.recommendation: Require approval before consequential writes; make the approved action and actor auditable.
findings.title: A write-capable tool has no approval gate

findings.explanation: A profile without an explicit managed source can lead to credentials being copied into config or images.
findings.recommendation: Use a customer-approved secret manager, workload identity, or environment reference; never commit secret values.
findings.title: Secret handling is not tied to a managed source

findings.explanation: Without an explicit transport-encryption setting, service-to-service traffic may be exposed.
findings.recommendation: Require TLS for customer and internal service traffic and verify certificate validation is enabled.
findings.title: Transport encryption is not confirmed

findings.explanation: Support and telemetry logs can accidentally become a second store of sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Redact customer identifiers and sensitive fields before data reaches logs or traces.
findings.title: Sensitive fields are not marked for redaction

findings.explanation: The team may not be able to reconstruct who invoked a tool or changed a policy.
findings.recommendation: Record actor, action, timestamp, target, and outcome without storing prompt or secret contents.
findings.title: Security-relevant actions are not audited

findings.explanation: There is no stated regression set to check customer-specific behavior before rollout.
findings.recommendation: Add representative success, refusal, boundary, and failure cases from the agreed workflow.
findings.title: No repeatable evaluation cases are declared

findings.explanation: Without a pass bar, the team cannot make a consistent launch decision from evaluation results.
findings.recommendation: Set a customer-approved pass rate between 0 and 1 and define which failures block release.
findings.title: An acceptance threshold is missing or invalid

findings.explanation: A team needs a known way to pause or revert a deployment if quality or safety falls.
findings.recommendation: Document who can pause rollout, how to restore the last known-good version, and how users are informed.
findings.title: A rollback path is not confirmed
